requirements.name: Hardware scanner
requirements.expected: Correct GPU name and VRAM (checked against nvidia-smi); CPU, RAM, storage, OS; live telemetry; unavailable metrics explained.

requirements.name: Hardware optimizer
requirements.expected: Every complexity level yields a complete configuration that fits the detected VRAM; QLoRA settings for base models.

requirements.name: AI creator
requirements.expected: Models from scratch with any supported architecture; exact parameter count; AI ID makeai://user/name/version.

requirements.name: Dataset system
requirements.expected: JSON, JSONL, TXT, CSV, Parquet and folders import; cleaning, filtering, dedup, shuffle, split, packing, token counts.

requirements.name: Tokenizer
requirements.expected: BPE, WordPiece, Unigram and SentencePiece train, save, reload; lossless round trip where the algorithm allows.

requirements.name: Training engine
requirements.expected: Training loss updates and decreases on real data; validation improves; all optimizers and schedulers work; checkpoints intact.

requirements.name: LoRA / QLoRA / adapters
requirements.expected: LoRA, QLoRA (NF4/FP4, INT8 where supported), adapters and full fine-tuning train and run; LoRA export loads in PEFT with identical logits.

requirements.name: Training dashboard
requirements.expected: Live step metrics and hardware telemetry streamed from the real training process.

requirements.name: ETA
requirements.expected: ETA updates during training and is derived from measured steps/second.

requirements.name: Kill Switch
requirements.expected: Training process terminates safely, saves a checkpoint, releases GPU memory; hard kill marks the run interrupted without corrupting checkpoints; resume works.

requirements.name: Pause / Resume
requirements.expected: No steps while paused; step, optimizer and scheduler state preserved on resume.

requirements.name: Performance Score
requirements.expected: Score updates when utilization, throughput, thermal or stability conditions change; never claims to rate model quality.

requirements.name: AI Playground
requirements.expected: Local streaming chat; temperature, seed, max tokens and stop sequences behave exactly; HF Qwen2 weights run natively with identical logits.

requirements.name: Import
requirements.expected: .makeai, .safetensors, .pt, .onnx and .gguf import and produce the same output as the source model.

requirements.name: Export
requirements.expected: ONNX matches PyTorch; GGUF runs in llama.cpp with identical output; HF folder loads in transformers; TensorRT availability reported honestly.

requirements.name: AI attribution
requirements.expected: Original creator remains after export/import through every format and several users; creator cannot be replaced.

requirements.name: Sharing
requirements.expected: Private/Link/Public visibility; public page shows every required field; downloads counted.

requirements.name: Discover
requirements.expected: Only real public AIs are listed, by category, each with its creator.

requirements.name: Evaluation
requirements.expected: Validation loss, perplexity, token accuracy; custom benchmarks with accuracy.

requirements.name: Projects
requirements.expected: Projects contain source, models, datasets, tokenizers, configs, evaluation, tests and docs; files cannot escape the project.

requirements.name: Local API security
requirements.expected: State-changing requests without the client header are rejected.

requirements.name: Standalone runtime (no Claude)
requirements.expected: With the development agent removed and no claude CLI, import, train, run and share still work; runtime code never imports Claude.

requirements.name: Claude development agent
requirements.expected: Optional. Plan (read-only) → approve / edit / cancel → implement and test. Absent agent hides the panel.
